records.text: Candace Owens said Desmond Holly entered Evergreen High School with a Smith & Wesson .38 Special revolver at 12:21, shot a 14-year-old student, then shot Matthew Silverstone at close range outside.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And the official story is that a 16-year-old student who attended Evergreen High School named Desmond Holly showed up to school with the Smith & Wesson 38 Special Revolver at 1221, two minutes before Charlie. ... He shot a 14-year-old student at close range while still inside of the school. Then Desmond leaves the school building. He crosses the football field. ... And comes across a second student. That student's name is Matthew Silverstone. And he shoots him at close range, shoots him once in the head, I believe also in the chest.

verification.notes: Official and independent reporting confirm that 16-year-old Desmond Holly began firing inside Evergreen High School at 12:21, used a Smith and Wesson .38-caliber revolver, wounded one student inside, exited the building, and shot Matthew Silverstone outside at close range. Reporting also identifies head and chest wounds suffered by Silverstone.

records.text: Delmer Martinez said he saw a young person holding another student by the neck, heard police order him to stop, and saw the young person shoot and throw the other student to the ground.
records.speaker: Delmer Martinez

appearances.snippet: was there where we saw a young person fighting. He came out holding another student by the neck and the police was saying something for him to stop and so the student shot at the other teen and threw him. He threw him to the ground.

verification.notes: CBS Colorado directly interviewed Delmer Martinez in Spanish. The published translation says he saw a young person holding another student by the neck, heard police tell the person to stop, and then saw the person shoot and throw the student to the ground. This closely matches the transcript context.
